## Notes from the Harbour

The harbour master kept a ledger of every vessel that crossed the bar, noting the tide and the weather. In winter the entries grew shorter and then stopped.

By spring the ledger was found under a coil of rope. Its last page held only the name of a pilot and a date that nobody could place in the history of the town.
